add_pack_note_curseforge: CurseForge modpacks download files with the API key from Settings. Files the author does not allow third parties to download are listed afterwards so you can fetch them yourself.
add_pack_note: Only the modpack files are placed here; Minecraft and the mod loader download on first launch.
add_launcher_hint: Pick a launcher's data folder: Prism / MultiMC, a .minecraft folder (official launcher, HMCL), CurseForge's Instances folder, or the Modrinth App data folder.
add_mode_copy_desc: Copies the whole game folder, so both launchers keep their own, at the cost of extra disk space.
add_mode_link_desc: Points at the original game folder, sharing saves and mods with no extra space. Do not open the same instance in both launchers at once.
add_zip_placeholder: Pick a .zip produced by Export instance
add_zip_note: You can also copy a whole instance folder into the instances folder.
add_imported_note: Minecraft itself and the mod loader are not moved over, they download on first launch.
add_imported_failed: These instances could not be imported:
add_installed_title: Installed “{name}”, a few files still need attention
add_manual_downloads: These files cannot be downloaded automatically (the author does not allow third-party downloads, or no CurseForge API key is set). Download them in a browser and put them in the listed place, otherwise the game may not start.
settings_show_running_badge: Show the running state on instance icons
settings_show_progress_window: Show the file check and download window when launching
settings_close_progress_when_done: Close that window once the game is up
settings_download_custom_hint: Enter the mirror's base URL. It must use the same layout as BMCLAPI: game files and version metadata at the root, libraries and Forge / NeoForge / Fabric under /maven/, assets under /assets/ and Fabric metadata under /fabric-meta/. Downloads fall back to the official servers when the mirror fails; with the URL left empty the official servers are used.
settings_download_hint: Use BMCLAPI when the official servers are slow for you. Game files, libraries, assets and Forge / NeoForge / Fabric are fetched from the mirror first and fall back to the official servers if it fails. Mod downloads from Modrinth and CurseForge are not affected.
crash_none_recorded: No crash record for this instance.
crash_unknown_desc: Nothing matched a common problem. Check the log below or open the crash report for clues.
crash_cause_java_too_old_desc: This version needs Java {version} or newer. Pick another Java in the instance settings, or clear it to let the launcher choose.
crash_cause_java_too_old_desc_unknown: The game or a mod needs a newer Java. Pick a newer Java in the instance settings.
crash_cause_java_too_new_desc: Old Forge (before 1.16) only runs on Java 8. Set Java 8 in the instance settings.
crash_cause_out_of_memory_desc: The game used up its memory. Raise the maximum memory in the instance settings; 6–8 GB is recommended for large modpacks.
crash_cause_heap_too_large_desc: The maximum memory is more than the computer has available, or Java is 32-bit. Lower the maximum memory or use a 64-bit Java.
crash_cause_graphics_driver_desc: OpenGL failed to start or the graphics driver crashed. Update the graphics driver; on laptops make sure the game uses the dedicated GPU.
crash_cause_missing_dependencies_desc: These mods need other mods to run. Install the missing dependencies.
crash_cause_incompatible_mods_desc: These mods require versions that do not match what is installed. Update or remove them.
crash_cause_duplicate_mods_desc: The same mod is installed more than once. Keep only one version.
crash_cause_mixin_failure_desc: Usually a conflict between mods or a version mismatch. Try updating or removing these mods.
crash_cause_corrupted_mod_file_desc: A mod file could not be read. Download it again.
crash_cause_corrupted_config_desc: Delete these files from the config folder; the game will recreate them.
crash_cause_suspected_mods: Mods named by the crash report
crash_cause_suspected_mods_desc: The crash report suspects these mods. Try updating or disabling them.
crash_cause_open_j9_desc: Minecraft does not support OpenJ9. Use a regular (HotSpot) Java, such as one the launcher downloads.
crash_cause_native_crash_desc: The JVM hit a native error, caused by a driver, Java itself or a mod using native libraries. Open the JVM error report for details.
settings_schematic_sync_hint: When on, schematic files (.litematic, .schem, .schematic, .nbt) in each instance's schematics folder are synced through a shared folder; other files are left alone. Syncing happens when you turn this on, before a game starts and after it exits, so schematics added, changed or deleted in one instance show up in the others on their next launch. Identical files are kept once, and files with the same name but different content are renamed. When turned off, each instance keeps its current schematics.
settings_schematic_sync_renamed: {count} schematics had the same name but different content and were renamed.
settings_schematic_sync_pending: Running instances will apply this after the game exits: {names}
settings_status_schematic_sync_off: Schematic sync off ({count} instances stopped syncing)

editor_mod_update_warning: The modpack author tested these exact mod versions together. Updating mods on your own can break the modpack: crashes, missing recipes, or worlds that no longer load.
editor_mod_update_warning_hint: To get newer mods, update the modpack itself from the Version page instead.

tools_prune_intro: Regenerates chunks that match the rules. Useful to shrink a save or to get new terrain in unvisited places after an update. Chunks shown in red will be cleaned up.
tools_regenerate_confirm: The selected chunks are removed from the save (with their builds, chests, entities and villager workstation records) and the game regenerates them from the seed the next time they load, as freshly generated terrain and structures. This cannot be undone.
tools_regenerate_note: Regeneration uses the current game version's terrain, so borders with older neighbouring chunks may not line up.
tools_status_regenerated: Reset {count} chunks; they regenerate when loaded in game
tools_status_regenerated_backup: Reset {count} chunks; they regenerate when loaded in game · backup: {path}
tools_slime_step_hint: Spacing of tried AFK spots; smaller is more precise and slower.
tools_scoring_enclose_hint: Every structure must be fully inside the spawning range. Best for witch huts.
tools_scoring_coverage_hint: A structure counts when enough of it is inside the range. Best for ocean monuments.
